BV179pb6uEkq.ingredients: Guifei pork, also called rib meat or second-layer pork by the creator, onion, green pepper and black pepper salt.
BV179pb6uEkq.quantities: Cut into dice-like cubes. Meat weight, seasoning amount and cooking time are unspecified.
steps: Cube the pork and put it directly in the pan without additional oil. Render its own fat and brown the meat.
Add onion and green pepper, stir fry, then season with black pepper salt and finish cooking.
BV179pb6uEkq.missing: Cube size, heat and doneness parameters are absent. Starch or baking soda from other videos is not added.

BV179pb6uEkq.ingredients: Spinach, sliced garlic, a little oil, salt, a little MSG and water.
BV179pb6uEkq.quantities: Amounts and times are not given.
steps: Blanch and drain the spinach.
Fry sliced garlic in a little oil, add spinach and stir fry.
Add salt, a little MSG and a little water to dissolve the seasoning. The video retains cleaned tender roots.
BV179pb6uEkq.missing: Blanching time and salt-oil quantities are unknown. Any retained roots must first be cleaned.

BV179pb6uEDX.ingredients: Guifei pork, ciabatta, egg, grated cheese, green pepper, black pepper salt and a little oil.
BV179pb6uEDX.quantities: One egg is visible. The pork is opened wider by leaving the first cut attached; other amounts are unspecified.
steps: Cut pork horizontally, leaving the first slice attached so it opens wider. Pan fry in a little oil until cooked and remove.
Use the remaining fat to fry an egg, then press the split bread onto it so they adhere.
Turn, add cheese, finely shaved green pepper and pork, season with black pepper salt and close.
Toast both sides until crisp and the cheese melts, then cut.
BV179pb6uEDX.missing: Pork thickness, cooking time and any earlier marinade are unspecified. Black pepper salt is the seasoning used in this segment.

BV179pb6uEDX.ingredients: Shrimp, cucumber, tomato, coriander, small chilies, minced garlic, lemon, Thai sweet-sour chili sauce and fish sauce.
BV179pb6uEDX.quantities: Fish sauce is a small amount. Other proportions and shrimp cooking time are unknown.
steps: Boil shrimp until cooked and peel; no fixed cooking time is given.
Peel cucumber, remove some wet core and cut. Cut tomatoes and chop cleaned coriander roots, stems and leaves.
Mix with chili, garlic, lemon slices and juice, Thai sauce and a little fish sauce.
Refrigerate to develop flavor before serving.
BV179pb6uEDX.missing: Shrimp weight, sauce quantities and refrigeration duration are unstated. Curvature alone is not a sufficient doneness test.

BV179pb6uEDX.ingredients: Coffee, water and a milk drink.
BV179pb6uEDX.quantities: Amounts, milk type and water temperature are unspecified.
steps: Add water to coffee and whisk with a hand frother until foamy.
Pour in the milk drink and mix.
BV179pb6uEDX.missing: Exact coffee product, additional sugar and milk identity are not clearly established.

BV179pb6uEDX.ingredients: Pork, a red char-siu-style marinade sauce and a little soy sauce. The exact sauce product is unknown.
BV179pb6uEDX.quantities: Prepared in the morning for roasting that evening. No ratio, roasting temperature or time is given.
steps: Coat remaining pork with the marinade sauce and a little soy sauce. Refrigerate for extended preparation in advance.

BV179pb6uEDX.missing: Actual roasting is absent, so this is not a complete char siu recipe. Refrigeration is an operational reminder.

BV171HD6cEwv.ingredients: Prepared fish, shredded ginger and scallions, oil and a little soy sauce. Earlier salting is unconfirmed.
BV171HD6cEwv.quantities: The demonstration sets 7 minutes steaming. Species, weight and thickness are unknown.

Remove, scatter scallions and pour the oil shown from a pan over the fish.
Add a little soy sauce before serving.
BV171HD6cEwv.missing: Heat, marinade and oil temperature are unspecified. Protruding fish eyes, mentioned in the video, are not a universal doneness test.

BV171HD6cEwv.ingredients: Eggs, warm water, salt, minced meat, soy sauce, scallions, a little water and oil. The meat species is unnamed.

steps: Mix eggs with warm water and a little salt and remove surface bubbles.
Cover the bowl and steam over medium heat for 7 minutes. The bowl cover is removed before the additional 2–3-minute rest under the steamer lid, as shown.
Fry minced meat separately, add soy sauce, a little water and scallions and cook into a topping.
Pour the topping over the custard.
BV171HD6cEwv.missing: Egg size, meat weight and meat species are unknown. The automatic subtitle's 23 minutes is incorrect.

Just before steaming, mix with salt, garlic, starch and peanut oil so the seasoning adheres.
Steam about 5 minutes and remove, avoiding excessive softening.

BV171HD6cEwv.quantities: Amount, seasoning and cooking time are unspecified.

Brown and cook through, season with black pepper salt and remove.

Stir fry cabbage, adding a little broth if the pan is dry.
Season with salt, cook and serve.
